summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Luxair converted purchase rights for three E190-E2 aircraft into firm orders and secured one additional purchase right. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing describes a routine commercial aircraft order, not a special situation. There are no deal mechanics, regulatory clocks, or risk-arb angles to analyze. The first delivery is expected at the end of 2028. This is an ordinary business update under Rule 13a-16.
